body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency standard for building and physical premises safety does not include the identification of and protection from vehicular traffic for out-of-school programs, as required by 98.41(a)(1)(v). (Plan Question 5.3.5cvii) • The Lead Agency does not require all staff in licensed centers or licensed family child care homes to complete pre-service or orientation training within three months on building and physical premises safety, as required by 98.44(b). body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency standard for emergency preparedness and response planning does not include all the required elements for licensed centers, licensed family child care homes, license-exempt centers, license-exempt family child care, or out-of-school programs, as required by 98.41(a)(1)(vii).
